content: Entity2Topic module extends the base model as follows. The final text representation vector $s$ is used as a context vector when constructing the topic vector $t$ in the pooling submodule. The topic vector $t$ is then concatenated to the decoder hidden state vectors $s_i$ , i.e. $s^{\prime }_i = [s_i; t]$ . The concatenated vector is finally used to create the output vector:
